errors.description: ack_vector_q is a multi-bit value produced in pwr_clk and sampled directly in soc_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
ack_pulse_q is a one-cycle pwr_clk pulse consumed directly in soc_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
ack_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample soc_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in soc_event_o.
power_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector power_mode_q before decoding in soc_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
pwr_rst_n is used as data inside soc_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
aon_snapshot_q combines pwr_clk payload state with soc_clk status state in aon_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
